prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Premium detailed voxel 3D architectural diorama for THE COMPANIONS, honey-oak and crafted painted cabinetry, finely stepped rounded bevels, realistic layered warm materials, tactile tiny voxels, physically convincing soft lighting/contact shadows. Every furniture piece needs individually resolved legs, joints, hardware, edge details; plants need species diversity; textiles need visible weave, trim and seams. Full object density of official reference, expanded usable space instead of clutter. Canonical human height 1.70m, room approximately 4.8m x 4.6m, desks about 1.5m wide and .75m high. Always a FUNCTIONAL StudyZone: tabletop clear central area, chair correctly facing work surface with leg clearance, space to pull it back, continuous open walking route from front to seat. Never block path with plants or props. No pets, no bed, no characters, no interface, no watermark, no exterior title text. Crisp standalone landscape 3:2 image, not multi-room contact sheet. Two-wall cutaway isometric gallery presentation, whole floor plinth fits in frame; soft ivory background #f6f2e9. Exact object construction and style family consistent with supplied library master (image2); image1 is the official art direction.
ROOM BRIEF: Lower row first room in official reference. A tranquil architect-designed white/ivory minimalist study studio with pale ash wood and black ergonomic details. Real rectangular two-wall shell with thick reveals, vertical finely ribbed pale timber accent behind built-in long white floating/leg-supported desk. Right cabinet module of three drawers with recessed pulls. One black/graphite ergonomic swivel chair in correct posture facing an open laptop. Large finely crafted pegboard above desk with individual hooks, baskets, scissors, stationery and small hanging plant. Three offset floating shelves holding mixed tiny ceramics, specific succulent species, a few books and a camera. Concealed warm linear light accents the wood slats. Left tall plant in gray ceramic cube pot, right low pale linen beanbag/ottoman with rich dense quilting and seams, gray-white short pile rug, small floor lantern. Desk details include adjustable jointed black tasklamp, laptop ports/keyboard, glass of pencils, spiral notebook, digital clock, cable tray and small organizer; tabletop intentionally clear to work. Minimal density of big furniture but full material and fabrication detail. White paint subtle roughness, precise drawer gaps and backing plates, articulated chair castors, fabric texture.
